+"""project tracking fields (Wave 9 / Agent Epsilon)
+
+Revision ID: 0014_project_tracking
+Revises: 0009_id_sequences
+Create Date: 2026-06-22
+
+Additive changes to `projects` table:
+- business_id (UNIQUE) — auto-generated SWA-2025-PRJ-NNN via id_gen
+- milestone — "Concept", "DBR", "Calculation", "Drawing", "Validation", "Closeout"
+- progress_indicators (JSONB) — e.g. {"design_pct": 30, "calc_pct": 10, "drawing_pct": 0}
+- status_updates (TEXT)
+- team_leader_id (UUID FK→users.id)
+- project_owner_id (UUID FK→users.id)
+- notes (TEXT)
+
+Backfills business_id for any existing rows by allocating a contiguous
+block from the id_sequence counter and updating id_sequence.last_value
+so future calls do not collide.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sqlalchemy as sa
+from alembic import op
+from sqlalchemy.dialects import postgresql
+
+
+revision = "0014_project_tracking"
+down_revision = "0009_id_sequences"
+branch_labels = None
+depends_on = None
+
+
+def upgrade() -> None:
+    op.add_column(
+        "projects",
+        sa.Column("business_id", sa.String(length=64), nullable=True),
+    )
+    op.add_column(
+        "projects",
+        sa.Column("milestone", sa.String(length=50), nullable=True),
+    )
+    op.add_column(
+        "projects",
+        sa.Column("progress_indicators", postgresql.JSONB(), nullable=True),
+    )
+    op.add_column(
+        "projects",
+        sa.Column("status_updates", sa.Text(), nullable=True),
+    )
+    op.add_column(
+        "projects",
+        sa.Column("team_leader_id", postgresql.UUID(as_uuid=True), nullable=True),
+    )
+    op.add_column(
+        "projects",
+        sa.Column("project_owner_id", postgresql.UUID(as_uuid=True), nullable=True),
+    )
+    op.add_column(
+        "projects",
+        sa.Column("notes", sa.Text(), nullable=True),
+    )
+
+    op.create_foreign_key(
+        "fk_projects_team_leader_id_users",
+        "projects",
+        "users",
+        ["team_leader_id"],
+        ["id"],
+        ondelete="SET NULL",
+    )
+    op.create_foreign_key(
+        "fk_projects_project_owner_id_users",
+        "projects",
+        "users",
+        ["project_owner_id"],
+        ["id"],
+        ondelete="SET NULL",
+    )
+
+    op.execute(
+        """
+        DO $$
+        DECLARE
+            yr INT := EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NOW())::INT;
+            counter INT := 0;
+            seq_exists BOOLEAN;
+            rec RECORD;
+        BEGIN
+            SELECT EXISTS (
+                SELECT 1 FROM id_sequence WHERE type_code = 'PRJ' AND year = yr
+            ) INTO seq_exists;
+
+            IF seq_exists THEN
+                SELECT last_value INTO counter FROM id_sequence
+                WHERE type_code = 'PRJ' AND year = yr;
+            END IF;
+
+            FOR rec IN SELECT id FROM projects WHERE business_id IS NULL ORDER BY created_at LOOP
+                counter := counter + 1;
+                UPDATE projects
+                SET business_id = 'SWA-' || yr || '-PRJ-' || LPAD(counter::TEXT, 3, '0')
+                WHERE id = rec.id;
+            END LOOP;
+
+            IF seq_exists THEN
+                UPDATE id_sequence
+                SET last_value = counter
+                WHERE type_code = 'PRJ' AND year = yr;
+            ELSIF counter > 0 THEN
+                INSERT INTO id_sequence (type_code, year, last_value)
+                VALUES ('PRJ', yr, counter);
+            END IF;
+        END $$;
+        """
+    )
+
+    op.execute("UPDATE projects SET milestone = 'Concept' WHERE milestone IS NULL")
+
+    op.create_index(
+        "ix_projects_business_id",
+        "projects",
+        ["business_id"],
+        unique=True,
+    )
+    op.create_index(
+        "ix_projects_milestone",
+        "projects",
+        ["milestone"],
+        unique=False,
+    )
+    op.create_index(
+        "ix_projects_team_leader_id",
+        "projects",
+        ["team_leader_id"],
+        unique=False,
+    )
+    op.create_index(
+        "ix_projects_project_owner_id",
+        "projects",
+        ["project_owner_id"],
+        unique=False,
+    )
+
+
+def downgrade() -> None:
+    op.drop_index("ix_projects_project_owner_id", table_name="projects")
+    op.drop_index("ix_projects_team_leader_id", table_name="projects")
+    op.drop_index("ix_projects_milestone", table_name="projects")
+    op.drop_index("ix_projects_business_id", table_name="projects")
+
+    op.drop_constraint("fk_projects_project_owner_id_users", "projects", type_="foreignkey")
+    op.drop_constraint("fk_projects_team_leader_id_users", "projects", type_="foreignkey")
+
+    op.drop_column("projects", "notes")
+    op.drop_column("projects", "project_owner_id")
+    op.drop_column("projects", "team_leader_id")
+    op.drop_column("projects", "status_updates")
+    op.drop_column("projects", "progress_indicators")
+    op.drop_column("projects", "milestone")
+    op.drop_column("projects", "business_id")

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import uuid
+from datetime import date
+
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from src.backend.models.service_agreement import ServiceAgreement
+
+
+def list_agreements(
+    db: Session,
+    page: int = 1,
+    page_size: int = 20,
+    client_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
+    status: str | None = None,
+) -> tuple[list[ServiceAgreement], int]:
+    query = db.query(ServiceAgreement)
+
+    if client_id is not None:
+        query = query.filter(ServiceAgreement.client_id == client_id)
+    if status:
+        query = query.filter(ServiceAgreement.status == status)
+
+    total = query.count()
+    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
+    items = query.order_by(ServiceAgreement.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()
+    return list(items), total
+
+
+def get_agreement(db: Session, agreement_id: uuid.UUID) -> ServiceAgreement | None:
+    return db.query(ServiceAgreement).filter(ServiceAgreement.id == agreement_id).first()
+
+
+def get_agreement_by_business_id(db: Session, agreement_business_id: str) -> ServiceAgreement | None:
+    return (
+        db.query(ServiceAgreement)
+        .filter(ServiceAgreement.agreement_id == agreement_business_id)
+        .first()
+    )
+
+
+def create_agreement(
+    db: Session,
+    *,
+    agreement_id: str,
+    client_id: uuid.UUID,
+    inquiry_id: uuid.UUID | None,
+    service_name: str,
+    start_date: date,
+    end_date: date | None,
+    total_tokens: int | None,
+    billing_model: str,
+    status: str,

+) -> ServiceAgreement:

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import uuid

+
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from src.backend.core.id_gen import next_business_id

+
+
+class InquiryAlreadyConvertedError(Exception):
+    """Raised when caller attempts to re-convert an inquiry."""
+
+
+def list_inquiries_service(
+    db: Session,
+    page: int = 1,
+    page_size: int = 20,
+    q: str | None = None,
+    status: str | None = None,
+) -> tuple[list[Inquiry], int, int, int]:

+    return items, total, page, page_size

+
+def get_inquiry_service(db: Session, inquiry_id: uuid.UUID) -> Inquiry | None:
+    return inquiry_repo.get_inquiry(db, inquiry_id)
+
+
+def create_inquiry_service(
+    db: Session,
+    data: InquiryCreate,
+    actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
+) -> Inquiry:
+    business_id = next_business_id(db, "INQ", date.today().year)
+    inquiry = inquiry_repo.create_inquiry(
+        db,
+        inquiry_id=business_id,
+        inquiry_date=data.inquiry_date,
+        inquiry_type=data.inquiry_type.value,
+        inquiry_source=data.inquiry_source,
+        client_name=data.client_name,
+        requirement_summary=data.requirement_summary,
+        estimated_value=data.estimated_value,
+        priority=data.priority.value,
+        status=data.status.value,
+        owner=data.owner,
+        technical_lead=data.technical_lead,
+        notes=data.notes,
+    )
+    audit_repo.create_entry(
+        db,
+        action="inquiry.create",
+        entity_type="inquiry",
+        entity_id=inquiry.id,
+        user_id=actor_id,
+        after_json={
+            "inquiry_id": inquiry.inquiry_id,
+            "client_name": inquiry.client_name,
+            "status": inquiry.status,
+        },
+    )
+    inquiry_repo.commit_inquiry(db, inquiry)
+    return inquiry
+
+
+def update_inquiry_service(
+    db: Session,
+    inquiry_id: uuid.UUID,
+    data: InquiryUpdate,
+    actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
+) -> Inquiry | None:
+    inquiry = inquiry_repo.get_inquiry(db, inquiry_id)
+    if not inquiry:
+        return None
+
+    before = {
+        "status": inquiry.status,
+        "client_name": inquiry.client_name,
+        "inquiry_type": inquiry.inquiry_type,
+        "priority": inquiry.priority,
+    }
+
+    if data.inquiry_date is not None:
+        inquiry.inquiry_date = data.inquiry_date
+    if data.inquiry_type is not None:
+        inquiry.inquiry_type = data.inquiry_type.value
+    if data.inquiry_source is not None:
+        inquiry.inquiry_source = data.inquiry_source
+    if data.client_name is not None:
+        inquiry.client_name = data.client_name
+    if data.requirement_summary is not None:
+        inquiry.requirement_summary = data.requirement_summary
+    if data.estimated_value is not None:
+        inquiry.estimated_value = data.estimated_value
+    if data.priority is not None:
+        inquiry.priority = data.priority.value
+    if data.status is not None:
+        inquiry.status = data.status.value
+    if data.owner is not None:
+        inquiry.owner = data.owner
+    if data.technical_lead is not None:
+        inquiry.technical_lead = data.technical_lead
+    if data.notes is not None:
+        inquiry.notes = data.notes
+
+    after = {
+        "status": inquiry.status,
+        "client_name": inquiry.client_name,
+        "inquiry_type": inquiry.inquiry_type,
+        "priority": inquiry.priority,
+    }
+    audit_repo.create_entry(
+        db,
+        action="inquiry.update",
+        entity_type="inquiry",
+        entity_id=inquiry.id,
+        user_id=actor_id,
+        before_json=before,
+        after_json=after,
+    )
+    inquiry_repo.commit_inquiry(db, inquiry)
+    return inquiry
+
+
+def delete_inquiry_service(
+    db: Session,
+    inquiry_id: uuid.UUID,
+    actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
+) -> bool:
+    inquiry = inquiry_repo.get_inquiry(db, inquiry_id)
+    if not inquiry:
+        return False
+
+    audit_repo.create_entry(
+        db,
+        action="inquiry.delete",
+        entity_type="inquiry",
+        entity_id=inquiry.id,
+        user_id=actor_id,
+        before_json={"inquiry_id": inquiry.inquiry_id, "client_name": inquiry.client_name},
+    )
+    inquiry_repo.delete_inquiry(db, inquiry)
+    return True
+
+
+VALID_INQUIRY_STATUSES = {s.value for s in InquiryStatus}
+
+
+def transition_inquiry_service(
+    db: Session,
+    inquiry_id: uuid.UUID,
+    new_status: InquiryStatus,
+    actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
+    *,
+    client_code: str | None = None,
+    client_primary_email: str | None = None,
+    service_name: str | None = None,
+    start_date: date | None = None,
+) -> tuple[Inquiry, "ServiceAgreement | None"]:
+    inquiry = inquiry_repo.get_inquiry(db, inquiry_id)
+    if not inquiry:
+        raise LookupError("inquiry not found")
+
+    if new_status.value not in VALID_INQUIRY_STATUSES:
+        raise ValueError(f"invalid status: {new_status}")
+
+    before_status = inquiry.status
+
+    if new_status == InquiryStatus.CONVERTED:
+        if inquiry.status == InquiryStatus.CONVERTED.value:
+            raise InquiryAlreadyConvertedError("inquiry already converted")
+        missing: list[str] = []
+        if not client_code:
+            missing.append("client_code")
+        if not client_primary_email:
+            missing.append("client_primary_email")
+        if not service_name:
+            missing.append("service_name")
+        if start_date is None:
+            missing.append("start_date")
+        if missing:
+            raise ValueError(f"missing required fields for Converted: {', '.join(missing)}")
+
+        assert client_code and client_primary_email and service_name and start_date is not None
+
+        from src.backend.db.repositories import agreement_repo
+
+        business_id = next_business_id(db, "SA", date.today().year)
+        client, agreement = inquiry_repo.convert_inquiry(
+            db,
+            inquiry,
+            client_code=client_code,
+            client_primary_email=client_primary_email,
+            service_name=service_name,
+            start_date=start_date,
+        )
+        agreement.agreement_id = business_id
+        agreement.client_id = client.id
+        db.flush()
+
+        audit_repo.create_entry(
+            db,
+            action="inquiry.convert",
+            entity_type="inquiry",
+            entity_id=inquiry.id,
+            user_id=actor_id,
+            before_json={"status": before_status},
+            after_json={
+                "status": inquiry.status,
+                "client_id": str(client.id),
+                "agreement_id": str(agreement.id),
+            },
+        )
+        db.commit()
+        db.refresh(inquiry)
+        db.refresh(agreement)
+        return inquiry, agreement
+
+    inquiry.status = new_status.value
+    audit_repo.create_entry(
+        db,
+        action="inquiry.status_transition",
+        entity_type="inquiry",
+        entity_id=inquiry.id,
+        user_id=actor_id,
+        before_json={"status": before_status},
+        after_json={"status": inquiry.status},
+    )
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(inquiry)
+    return inquiry, None

def list_users_service(
    db: Session,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
    q: str | None = None,
    role: str | None = None,
    is_active: bool | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[User], int, int, int]:
    items, total = list_users(db, page, page_size, q, role, is_active)
    return items, total, page, page_size


def create_user_service(db: Session, data: UserCreate, actor_id: uuid.UUID | None) -> User:
    password_hash = hash_password(data.password)
    user = create_user(db, data.email, data.name, password_hash, data.role.value)

    create_entry(
        db,
        action="user.create",
        entity_type="user",
        entity_id=user.id,
        user_id=actor_id,
        after_json={
            "id": str(user.id),
            "email": user.email,
            "name": user.name,
            "role": user.role,
        },
    )

    return user


def get_user_service(db: Session, user_id: uuid.UUID) -> User | None:
    return get_by_id(db, user_id)


def update_user_service(
    db: Session,
    user_id: uuid.UUID,
    data: UserUpdate,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
    is_self: bool = False,
) -> User | None:
    user = get_by_id(db, user_id)
    if not user:
        return None

    before_json = {
        "name": user.name,
        "role": user.role,
        "is_active": user.is_active,
    }

    if data.name is not None:
        user.name = data.name
    if data.role is not None:
        if is_self:
            return None
        user.role = data.role
    if data.is_active is not None:
        if is_self:
            return None
        user.is_active = data.is_active

    update_user(db, user)

    after_json = {
        "name": user.name,
        "role": user.role,
        "is_active": user.is_active,
    }

    create_entry(
        db,
        action="user.update",
        entity_type="user",
        entity_id=user.id,
        user_id=actor_id,
        before_json=before_json,
        after_json=after_json,
    )

    return user


def soft_delete_user_service(
    db: Session,
    user_id: uuid.UUID,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
) -> bool:
    user = get_by_id(db, user_id)
    if not user:
        return False

    before_json = {
        "deleted_at": None,
    }

    soft_delete_user(db, user)

    after_json = {
        "deleted_at": str(user.deleted_at),
    }

    create_entry(
        db,
        action="user.delete",
        entity_type="user",
        entity_id=user.id,
        user_id=actor_id,
        before_json=before_json,
        after_json=after_json,
    )

    return True

display.text:
"""Business-ID generator.

Produces IDs like `SWA-2025-CLT-001`. Uses a DB-backed sequence counter
(`IdSequence`) so each (type_code, year) pair advances atomically.

Pass `year=0` for "continuous across years" (per meeting: DBR/CAS/GAD numbers
do not reset per year).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.models.id_sequence import IdSequence


def current_year() -> int:
    return datetime.utcnow().year


def next_business_id(db: Session, type_code: str, year: int | None = None) -> str:
    """Generate the next business ID for `type_code`.

    Args:
        db: SQLAlchemy session.
        type_code: Short code like `CLT`, `INQ`, `SA`, `TKN`, `PRJ`, `EMP`,
            `FDB`, `TRN`, `HW`, `PROC`, `COL`, `INN`, `FB`, `CMP`,
            `IG`, `LI`, `WEB`, `CON`, `DBR`, `CAS`, `GAD`, `KDR`, `RDP`,
            `VAL`, `RPT`, `OTH`.
        year: Calendar year (defaults to current year). Pass `0` for
            continuous counters (e.g. DBR numbers per the meeting transcript).

    Returns:
        A formatted ID string like `SWA-2025-CLT-001`.
    """
    if year is None:
        year = current_year()

    seq = (
        db.query(IdSequence)
        .filter_by(type_code=type_code, year=year)
        .with_for_update()
        .one_or_none()
    )
    if seq is None:
        seq = IdSequence(type_code=type_code, year=year, last_value=0)
        db.add(seq)
        db.flush()

    seq.last_value += 1
    db.flush()

    return f"SWA-{year}-{type_code}-{seq.last_value:03d}"

import uuid
from datetime import UTC, datetime

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.models.user import User


def get_by_email(db: Session, email: str) -> User | None:
    return db.query(User).filter(User.email == email, User.deleted_at.is_(None)).first()


def get_by_id(db: Session, user_id: uuid.UUID) -> User | None:
    return db.query(User).filter(User.id == user_id, User.deleted_at.is_(None)).first()


def list_users(
    db: Session,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
    q: str | None = None,
    role: str | None = None,
    is_active: bool | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[User], int]:
    query = db.query(User).filter(User.deleted_at.is_(None))

    if q:
        search = f"%{q}%"
        query = query.filter(User.email.ilike(search) | User.name.ilike(search))

    if role:
        query = query.filter(User.role == role)

    if is_active is not None:
        query = query.filter(User.is_active == is_active)

    total = query.count()
    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
    items = query.order_by(User.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()

    return list(items), total


def create(db: Session, email: str, name: str, password_hash: str, role: str) -> User:
    user = User(
        email=email,
        name=name,
        password_hash=password_hash,
        role=role,
    )
    db.add(user)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(user)
    return user


def update(db: Session, user: User) -> User:
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(user)
    return user


def soft_delete(db: Session, user: User) -> User:
    user.deleted_at = datetime.now(UTC)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(user)
    return user

import uuid

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, File, Form, HTTPException, Query, UploadFile, status
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.core.deps import get_current_user, require_role
from src.backend.core.roles import Role
from src.backend.db.repositories.boq_repo import (
    count_items,
    get_with_items,
    list_by_project,
    soft_delete,
)
from src.backend.db.session import get_db
from src.backend.models.user import User
from src.backend.schemas.boq import BOQItemListResponse, BOQItemRead, BOQListResponse, BOQRead
from src.backend.services.boq_service import upload_boq

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api", tags=["boqs"])


@router.post("/projects/{project_id}/boqs", status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def create_boq(
    project_id: uuid.UUID,
    file: UploadFile = File(...),  # noqa: B008
    notes: str | None = Form(None),  # noqa: B008
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),  # noqa: B008
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),  # noqa: B008
):
    if not file.filename:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="No file provided")

    content_type = file.content_type or ""
    file_bytes = file.file.read()

    try:
        result = upload_boq(
            db=db,
            project_id=project_id,
            file_bytes=file_bytes,
            file_name=file.filename,
            content_type=content_type,
            parsed_by=current_user.id,
            notes=notes,
        )
        return result
    except ValueError as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(e)) from e


@router.get("/projects/{project_id}/boqs", response_model=BOQListResponse)
def list_boqs(
    project_id: uuid.UUID,
    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),  # noqa: B008
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),  # noqa: B008
    page: int = Query(default=1, ge=1),
    page_size: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=100),
):
    items, total = list_by_project(db, project_id, page=page, page_size=page_size)
    result = []
    for boq in items:
        d = BOQRead.model_validate(boq)
        d.item_count = count_items(db, boq.id)
        result.append(d)
    return BOQListResponse(items=result, total=total, page=page, page_size=page_size)


@router.get("/boqs/{boq_id}", response_model=BOQRead)
def get_boq(
    boq_id: uuid.UUID,
    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),  # noqa: B008
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),  # noqa: B008
):
    boq = get_with_items(db, boq_id)
    if not boq:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="BOQ not found")
    d = BOQRead.model_validate(boq)
    d.item_count = len(boq.items) if boq.items else 0
    return d


@router.get("/boqs/{boq_id}/items", response_model=BOQItemListResponse)
def list_boq_items(
    boq_id: uuid.UUID,
    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),  # noqa: B008
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),  # noqa: B008
    page: int = Query(default=1, ge=1),
    page_size: int = Query(default=50, ge=1, le=200),
):
    from src.backend.models.boq import BOQItem

    query = db.query(BOQItem).filter(BOQItem.boq_id == boq_id).order_by(BOQItem.line_number)
    total = query.count()
    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
    items = query.offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()
    return BOQItemListResponse(
        items=[BOQItemRead.model_validate(i) for i in items],
        total=total,
        page=page,
        page_size=page_size,
    )


@router.delete("/boqs/{boq_id}", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
def delete_boq(
    boq_id: uuid.UUID,
    current_user: User = Depends(require_role(Role.ADMIN)),  # noqa: B008
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),  # noqa: B008
):
    success = soft_delete(db, boq_id)
    if not success:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="BOQ not found")

import uuid
from pathlib import Path

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.core.boq_parser import parse_excel, parse_json
from src.backend.db.repositories.audit_repo import create_entry
from src.backend.db.repositories.boq_repo import create_boq, get_next_version_number

UPLOAD_DIR = Path("uploads/boqs")
MAX_FILE_SIZE = 10 * 1024 * 1024  # 10MB
ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = {".xlsx", ".json"}


def _ensure_dir(project_id: uuid.UUID) -> Path:
    d = UPLOAD_DIR / str(project_id)
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return d


def _save_file(project_id: uuid.UUID, file_name: str, file_bytes: bytes) -> str:
    d = _ensure_dir(project_id)
    safe_name = f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}_{file_name}"
    path = d / safe_name
    path.write_bytes(file_bytes)
    return str(path)


def upload_boq(
    db: Session,
    project_id: uuid.UUID,
    file_bytes: bytes,
    file_name: str,
    content_type: str | None,
    parsed_by: uuid.UUID | None,
    notes: str | None = None,
) -> dict:
    if len(file_bytes) > MAX_FILE_SIZE:
        raise ValueError("File exceeds 10MB limit")

    ext = Path(file_name).suffix.lower()
    if ext not in ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS:
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid file type. Allowed: {ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS}")

    if ext == ".xlsx":
        items = parse_excel(file_bytes)
    else:
        items = parse_json(file_bytes)

    if not items:
        raise ValueError("No valid line items found in file")

    file_path = _save_file(project_id, file_name, file_bytes)
    version_number = get_next_version_number(db, project_id)

    boq = create_boq(
        db=db,
        project_id=project_id,
        version_number=version_number,
        file_name=file_name,
        file_path=file_path,
        parsed_by=parsed_by,
        items=items,
        notes=notes,
    )

    create_entry(
        db,
        action="boq.upload",
        entity_type="boq",
        entity_id=boq.id,
        user_id=parsed_by,
        after_json={
            "project_id": str(project_id),
            "version_number": version_number,
            "file_name": file_name,
            "items_count": len(items),
        },
    )

    return {
        "id": boq.id,
        "project_id": boq.project_id,
        "version_number": boq.version_number,
        "file_name": boq.file_name,
        "file_path": boq.file_path,
        "parsed_by": boq.parsed_by,
        "parsed_at": boq.parsed_at,
        "notes": boq.notes,
        "is_active": boq.is_active,
        "created_at": boq.created_at,
        "item_count": len(items),
    }

import pytest
from httpx import AsyncClient
from sqlalchemy import text

async def test_admin_can_list_users(authed_admin_client: AsyncClient, admin_user):
    r = await authed_admin_client.get("/api/users")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert "items" in body
    assert any(u["email"] == "admin@swa.co.in" for u in body["items"])


async def test_pm_cannot_list_users(authed_pm_client: AsyncClient):
    r = await authed_pm_client.get("/api/users")
    assert r.status_code == 403


async def test_admin_can_create_user(authed_admin_client: AsyncClient):
    r = await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/users",
        json={
            "email": "designer@swa.co.in",
            "name": "Designer",
            "password": "design123!",
            "role": "designer",
        },
    )
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["email"] == "designer@swa.co.in"
    assert body["role"] == "designer"
    assert "password" not in body
    assert "password_hash" not in body


async def test_create_user_duplicate_email(authed_admin_client: AsyncClient, admin_user):
    r = await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/users",
        json={
            "email": "admin@swa.co.in",
            "name": "Dup",
            "password": "x1234567!",
            "role": "viewer",
        },
    )
    assert r.status_code in (409, 400)


async def test_create_user_short_password(authed_admin_client: AsyncClient):
    r = await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/users",
        json={
            "email": "short@swa.co.in",
            "name": "Short",
            "password": "abc",
            "role": "viewer",
        },
    )
    assert r.status_code == 422


async def test_pm_cannot_create_user(authed_pm_client: AsyncClient):
    r = await authed_pm_client.post(
        "/api/users",
        json={
            "email": "x@swa.co.in",
            "name": "X",
            "password": "x1234567!",
            "role": "viewer",
        },
    )
    assert r.status_code == 403


async def test_self_can_read_own(authed_pm_client: AsyncClient, pm_user):

    assert r.status_code == 200


async def test_pm_cannot_read_other(authed_pm_client: AsyncClient, admin_user):
    r = await authed_pm_client.get(f"/api/users/{admin_user.id}")
    assert r.status_code == 403


async def test_self_can_update_own_name(authed_pm_client: AsyncClient, pm_user):
    r = await authed_pm_client.patch(f"/api/users/{pm_user.id}", json={"name": "PM Renamed"})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.json()["name"] == "PM Renamed"


async def test_self_cannot_update_own_role(authed_pm_client: AsyncClient, pm_user):
    r = await authed_pm_client.patch(f"/api/users/{pm_user.id}", json={"role": "admin"})
    assert r.status_code == 403


async def test_soft_delete(authed_admin_client: AsyncClient, db_session):
    r = await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/users",
        json={
            "email": "del@swa.co.in",
            "name": "Del",
            "password": "x1234567!",
            "role": "viewer",
        },
    )
    user_id = r.json()["id"]
    r2 = await authed_admin_client.delete(f"/api/users/{user_id}")
    assert r2.status_code == 204
    r3 = await authed_admin_client.get("/api/users")
    emails = [u["email"] for u in r3.json()["items"]]
    assert "del@swa.co.in" not in emails
    row = db_session.execute(
        text("SELECT deleted_at FROM users WHERE email = :email"), {"email": "del@swa.co.in"}
    ).fetchone()
    assert row is not None

    with engine.connect() as conn:

        tables = [t.name for t in Base.metadata.sorted_tables if t.name in existing]

        if tables:
            seq_result = conn.execute(text(
                "SELECT relname FROM pg_class WHERE relkind = 'S' AND relnamespace = 'public'::regnamespace"

import uuid
from datetime import date, datetime
from decimal import Decimal

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field


class TaskCreate(BaseModel):
    title: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)
    description: str | None = None
    priority: str = "medium"
    assignee_id: uuid.UUID | None = None
    due_date: date | None = None
    estimated_hours: Decimal | None = None
    parent_id: uuid.UUID | None = None
    boq_item_id: uuid.UUID | None = None

    title: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=200)
    description: str | None = None
    priority: str | None = None
    assignee_id: uuid.UUID | None = None
    due_date: date | None = None
    estimated_hours: Decimal | None = None
    is_deleted: bool | None = None


class TaskStatusTransition(BaseModel):
    status: str


class TaskDependencyCreate(BaseModel):
    depends_on_task_id: uuid.UUID

    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)
    id: uuid.UUID
    task_id: uuid.UUID
    depends_on_task_id: uuid.UUID
    created_at: datetime


class TaskRead(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)

    title: str
    description: str | None
    status: str
    priority: str

    estimated_hours: Decimal | None

    boq_item_id: uuid.UUID | None

    items: list[TaskRead]

    page_size: int

import uuid
from collections import deque

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.db.repositories.audit_repo import create_entry
from src.backend.models.enums import (
    TaskPriority,
    TaskStatus,
    can_transition_status,
)
from src.backend.models.task import Task, TaskDependency
from src.backend.schemas.task import TaskCreate, TaskUpdate


def _task_to_dict(task: Task, include_subtasks: bool = False, include_deps: bool = False) -> dict:
    assignee_name = task.assignee.name if task.assignee else None
    creator_name = task.creator.name if task.creator else None

    subtasks = []
    if include_subtasks:
        for st in task.subtasks:
            if not st.is_deleted:
                subtasks.append(_task_to_dict(st, include_subtasks=True))

    deps = []
    if include_deps:
        for d in task.dependencies:
            deps.append({
                "id": str(d.id),
                "task_id": str(d.task_id),
                "depends_on_task_id": str(d.depends_on_task_id),
                "created_at": d.created_at.isoformat() if d.created_at else None,
            })

    return {
        "id": str(task.id),
        "project_id": str(task.project_id),
        "parent_id": str(task.parent_id) if task.parent_id else None,
        "title": task.title,
        "description": task.description,
        "status": task.status,
        "priority": task.priority,
        "assignee_id": str(task.assignee_id) if task.assignee_id else None,
        "assignee_name": assignee_name,
        "created_by": str(task.created_by),
        "creator_name": creator_name,
        "due_date": task.due_date.isoformat() if task.due_date else None,
        "estimated_hours": float(task.estimated_hours) if task.estimated_hours else None,
        "actual_hours": float(task.actual_hours) if task.actual_hours else None,
        "boq_item_id": str(task.boq_item_id) if task.boq_item_id else None,
        "is_deleted": task.is_deleted,
        "created_at": task.created_at.isoformat() if task.created_at else None,
        "updated_at": task.updated_at.isoformat() if task.updated_at else None,
        "subtasks": subtasks,
        "dependencies": deps,
    }


def _check_cyclic_dependency(db: Session, task_id: uuid.UUID, depends_on_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
    visited = set()
    queue = deque([depends_on_id])
    while queue:
        current = queue.popleft()
        if current == task_id:
            return True
        if current in visited:
            continue
        visited.add(current)
        deps = db.query(TaskDependency).filter(TaskDependency.task_id == current).all()
        for dep in deps:
            queue.append(dep.depends_on_task_id)
    return False


def _get_incomplete_dependencies(db: Session, task_id: uuid.UUID) -> list[Task]:
    deps = db.query(TaskDependency).filter(TaskDependency.task_id == task_id).all()
    incomplete = []
    for dep in deps:
        blocker = db.query(Task).filter(Task.id == dep.depends_on_task_id, Task.is_deleted == False).first()
        if blocker and blocker.status != TaskStatus.DONE.value:
            incomplete.append(blocker)
    return incomplete


def create_task_service(db: Session, project_id: uuid.UUID, data: TaskCreate, actor_id: uuid.UUID) -> dict:
    task = Task(
        project_id=project_id,
        title=data.title,
        description=data.description,
        priority=data.priority or TaskPriority.MEDIUM.value,
        assignee_id=data.assignee_id,
        created_by=actor_id,
        due_date=data.due_date,
        estimated_hours=data.estimated_hours,
        parent_id=data.parent_id,
        boq_item_id=data.boq_item_id,
        status=TaskStatus.TODO.value,
    )
    db.add(task)
    db.flush()

    create_entry(
        db,
        action="task.create",
        entity_type="task",
        entity_id=task.id,
        user_id=actor_id,
        after_json={"title": task.title, "status": task.status},
    )
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(task)
    return _task_to_dict(task)


def get_task_service(db: Session, task_id: uuid.UUID) -> dict | None:
    task = db.query(Task).filter(Task.id == task_id, Task.is_deleted == False).first()
    if not task:
        return None
    return _task_to_dict(task, include_subtasks=True, include_deps=True)


def list_tasks_service(
    db: Session,
    project_id: uuid.UUID,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
    tree: bool = False,
    assignee_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[dict], int]:
    query = db.query(Task).filter(Task.project_id == project_id, Task.is_deleted == False)
    if assignee_id:
        query = query.filter(Task.assignee_id == assignee_id)
    total = query.count()
    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
    tasks = query.order_by(Task.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()

    if tree:
        task_dicts = [_task_to_dict(t, include_subtasks=True) for t in tasks]
        return task_dicts, total

    result = []
    for t in tasks:
        result.append(_task_to_dict(t))
    return result, total


def update_task_service(db: Session, task_id: uuid.UUID, data: TaskUpdate, actor_id: uuid.UUID) -> dict | None:
    task = db.query(Task).filter(Task.id == task_id, Task.is_deleted == False).first()
    if not task:
        return None

    before = _task_to_dict(task)

    if data.title is not None:
        task.title = data.title
    if data.description is not None:
        task.description = data.description
    if data.priority is not None:
        task.priority = data.priority
    if data.assignee_id is not None:
        task.assignee_id = data.assignee_id
    if data.due_date is not None:
        task.due_date = data.due_date
    if data.estimated_hours is not None:
        task.estimated_hours = data.estimated_hours
    if data.is_deleted is not None:
        task.is_deleted = data.is_deleted

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(task)

    after = _task_to_dict(task)
    create_entry(
        db,
        action="task.update",
        entity_type="task",
        entity_id=task.id,
        user_id=actor_id,
        before_json=before,
        after_json=after,
    )
    return after


def delete_task_service(db: Session, task_id: uuid.UUID, actor_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
    task = db.query(Task).filter(Task.id == task_id, Task.is_deleted == False).first()
    if not task:
        return False

    def soft_delete_children(parent_id: uuid.UUID):
        children = db.query(Task).filter(Task.parent_id == parent_id, Task.is_deleted == False).all()
        for child in children:
            child.is_deleted = True
            soft_delete_children(child.id)

    task.is_deleted = True
    soft_delete_children(task_id)
    db.commit()

    create_entry(
        db,
        action="task.delete",
        entity_type="task",
        entity_id=task.id,
        user_id=actor_id,
        before_json={"title": task.title},
    )
    return True


def transition_task_status_service(
    db: Session,
    task_id: uuid.UUID,
    new_status: str,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
) -> dict:
    task = db.query(Task).filter(Task.id == task_id, Task.is_deleted == False).first()
    if not task:
        raise ValueError("Task not found")

    try:
        from_status = TaskStatus(task.status)
        to_status = TaskStatus(new_status)
    except ValueError:
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid status: {new_status}")

    if not can_transition_status(from_status, to_status):
        raise ValueError(f"Cannot transition from {from_status.value} to {to_status.value}")

    if to_status in (TaskStatus.IN_PROGRESS, TaskStatus.DONE):
        incomplete = _get_incomplete_dependencies(db, task_id)
        if incomplete:
            names = [t.title for t in incomplete]
            raise ValueError(f"Dependencies not done: {', '.join(names)}")

    before_status = task.status
    task.status = to_status.value
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(task)

    create_entry(
        db,
        action="task.status_change",
        entity_type="task",
        entity_id=task.id,
        user_id=actor_id,
        before_json={"status": before_status},
        after_json={"status": to_status.value},
    )
    return _task_to_dict(task)


def add_dependency_service(
    db: Session,
    task_id: uuid.UUID,
    depends_on_task_id: uuid.UUID,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
) -> dict:
    if task_id == depends_on_task_id:
        raise ValueError("Task cannot depend on itself")

    existing = db.query(TaskDependency).filter(
        TaskDependency.task_id == task_id,
        TaskDependency.depends_on_task_id == depends_on_task_id,
    ).first()
    if existing:
        raise ValueError("Dependency already exists")

    if _check_cyclic_dependency(db, task_id, depends_on_task_id):
        raise ValueError("Adding this dependency would create a cycle")

    task = db.query(Task).filter(Task.id == task_id, Task.is_deleted == False).first()
    if not task:
        raise ValueError("Task not found")

    blocker = db.query(Task).filter(Task.id == depends_on_task_id, Task.is_deleted == False).first()
    if not blocker:
        raise ValueError("Blocking task not found")

    dep = TaskDependency(task_id=task_id, depends_on_task_id=depends_on_task_id)
    db.add(dep)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(dep)

    create_entry(
        db,
        action="task.dependency_add",
        entity_type="task",
        entity_id=task_id,
        user_id=actor_id,
        after_json={"depends_on": str(depends_on_task_id)},
    )
    return _task_to_dict(task, include_deps=True)


def remove_dependency_service(
    db: Session,
    task_id: uuid.UUID,
    dependency_id: uuid.UUID,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
) -> bool:
    dep = db.query(TaskDependency).filter(
        TaskDependency.id == dependency_id,
        TaskDependency.task_id == task_id,
    ).first()
    if not dep:
        return False

    db.delete(dep)
    db.commit()

    task = db.query(Task).filter(Task.id == task_id).first()
    if task:
        db.refresh(task)

    create_entry(
        db,
        action="task.dependency_remove",
        entity_type="task",
        entity_id=task_id,
        user_id=actor_id,
        before_json={"dependency_id": str(dependency_id)},
    )
    return True


def list_my_tasks_service(
    db: Session,
    user_id: uuid.UUID,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
) -> tuple[list[dict], int]:
    query = db.query(Task).filter(Task.assignee_id == user_id, Task.is_deleted == False)
    total = query.count()
    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
    tasks = query.order_by(Task.due_date.asc().nulls_last(), Task.priority.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()
    return [_task_to_dict(t) for t in tasks], total

import uuid
from datetime import date, datetime
from decimal import Decimal

    Boolean,

from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import UUID
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column, relationship

from src.backend.db.base import Base
from src.backend.models.enums import TaskPriority, TaskStatus


class Task(Base):
    __tablename__ = "tasks"

    id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4)
    project_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), ForeignKey("projects.id"), nullable=False, index=True)
    parent_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID | None] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), ForeignKey("tasks.id"), nullable=True, index=True)
    title: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(200), nullable=False)
    description: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)
    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(20), nullable=False, default=TaskStatus.TODO.value)
    priority: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(20), nullable=False, default=TaskPriority.MEDIUM.value)
    assignee_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID | None] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), ForeignKey("users.id"), nullable=True, index=True)
    created_by: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), ForeignKey("users.id"), nullable=False)
    due_date: Mapped[date | None] = mapped_column(Date, nullable=True)
    estimated_hours: Mapped[Decimal | None] = mapped_column(Numeric(6, 2), nullable=True)
    actual_hours: Mapped[Decimal | None] = mapped_column(Numeric(6, 2), nullable=True)
    boq_item_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID | None] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), ForeignKey("boq_items.id"), nullable=True)
    is_deleted: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, nullable=False, default=False)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), nullable=False)
    updated_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), onupdate=func.now(), nullable=False)

    project: Mapped["Project"] = relationship("Project", back_populates="tasks")
    parent: Mapped["Task"] = relationship("Task", remote_side=[id], back_populates="subtasks")
    subtasks: Mapped[list["Task"]] = relationship("Task", back_populates="parent", cascade="all, delete-orphan")
    assignee: Mapped["User"] = relationship("User", foreign_keys=[assignee_id])
    creator: Mapped["User"] = relationship("User", foreign_keys=[created_by])
    dependencies: Mapped[list["TaskDependency"]] = relationship("TaskDependency", foreign_keys="TaskDependency.task_id", cascade="all, delete-orphan")
    dependents: Mapped[list["TaskDependency"]] = relationship("TaskDependency", foreign_keys="TaskDependency.depends_on_task_id", cascade="all, delete-orphan")


class TaskDependency(Base):
    __tablename__ = "task_dependencies"
    __table_args__ = (
        UniqueConstraint("task_id", "depends_on_task_id", name="uq_task_dependency"),
    )

    id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4)
    task_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), ForeignKey("tasks.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False, index=True)
    depends_on_task_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), ForeignKey("tasks.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False, index=True)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), nullable=False)

import sys
from logging.config import fileConfig
from pathlib import Path

from alembic import context
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, pool

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]))

import src.backend.models  # noqa: F401 - needed for Base.metadata
from src.backend.core.config import settings
from src.backend.db.base import Base

config = context.config
config.set_main_option("sqlalchemy.url", settings.DATABASE_URL)

if config.config_file_name is not None:
    fileConfig(config.config_file_name)

target_metadata = Base.metadata


def run_migrations_offline() -> None:
    url = config.get_main_option("sqlalchemy.url")
    context.configure(
        url=url,
        target_metadata=target_metadata,
        literal_binds=True,
        dialect_opts={"paramstyle": "named"},
    )
    with context.begin_transaction():
        context.run_migrations()


def run_migrations_online() -> None:
    db_url = config.get_main_option("sqlalchemy.url")
    assert db_url is not None
    connectable = create_engine(db_url, poolclass=pool.NullPool)
    with connectable.connect() as connection:
        context.configure(connection=connection, target_metadata=target_metadata)
        with context.begin_transaction():
            context.run_migrations()


if context.is_offline_mode():
    run_migrations_offline()
else:
    run_migrations_online()

from collections.abc import Callable
from uuid import UUID

from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException
from fastapi.security import HTTPAuthorizationCredentials, HTTPBearer
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.core.roles import Role, role_includes
from src.backend.core.security import decode_token
from src.backend.db.repositories.user_repo import get_by_id
from src.backend.db.session import get_db
from src.backend.models.user import User

security_scheme = HTTPBearer()


def get_current_user(
    creds: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Depends(security_scheme),  # noqa: B008
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),  # noqa: B008
) -> User:
    try:
        payload = decode_token(creds.credentials)
    except Exception as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid or expired token") from e
    if payload.get("type") != "access":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Wrong token type")
    user = get_by_id(db, UUID(payload["sub"]))
    if not user or not user.is_active or user.deleted_at:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="User not active")
    return user


def require_role(required: Role) -> Callable[[User], User]:
    def _checker(user: User = Depends(get_current_user)) -> User:  # noqa: B008
        if not role_includes(Role(user.role), required):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Insufficient role")
        return user

    return _checker

import uuid
from decimal import Decimal

from sqlalchemy import func
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.db.repositories.audit_repo import create_entry
from src.backend.models.time_log import TimeLog, WorkType
from src.backend.models.user import User
from src.backend.schemas.time_log import TimeLogCreate, TimeLogUpdate


def _snapshot_role(db: Session, employee_id: uuid.UUID) -> str | None:
    u = db.query(User).filter(User.id == employee_id).first()
    if not u:
        return None
    return u.employee_role_code or u.role


def list_time_logs(
    db: Session,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
    employee_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
    work_type: str | None = None,
    project_id: str | None = None,
):
    q = db.query(TimeLog)
    if employee_id:
        q = q.filter(TimeLog.employee_id == employee_id)
    if work_type:
        q = q.filter(TimeLog.work_type == work_type)
    if project_id:
        q = q.filter(TimeLog.reference_id == project_id)
    total = q.count()
    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
    items = q.order_by(TimeLog.log_date.desc(), TimeLog.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()
    return items, total


def create_time_log(db: Session, data: TimeLogCreate, actor_id: uuid.UUID | None) -> TimeLog:
    role_snapshot = _snapshot_role(db, data.employee_id)
    log = TimeLog(
        log_date=data.log_date,
        employee_id=data.employee_id,
        employee_role_at_log=role_snapshot,
        work_type=data.work_type.value,
        reference_id=data.reference_id,
        reference_kind=data.reference_kind.value if data.reference_kind else None,
        revision=data.revision,
        project_name=data.project_name,
        activity_type=data.activity_type.value,
        software_used=data.software_used,
        work_mode=data.work_mode.value,
        hours_logged=data.hours_logged,
        billable_hours=data.billable_hours,
        remarks=data.remarks,
    )
    db.add(log)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(log)
    create_entry(
        db,
        action="time_log.create",
        entity_type="time_log",
        entity_id=log.id,
        user_id=actor_id,
        after_json={
            "employee_id": str(log.employee_id),
            "work_type": log.work_type,
            "hours_logged": float(log.hours_logged),
            "billable_hours": float(log.billable_hours),
        },
    )
    return log


def get_time_log(db: Session, log_id: uuid.UUID) -> TimeLog | None:
    return db.query(TimeLog).filter(TimeLog.id == log_id).first()


def update_time_log(db: Session, log_id: uuid.UUID, data: TimeLogUpdate, actor_id: uuid.UUID | None) -> TimeLog | None:
    log = get_time_log(db, log_id)
    if not log:
        return None
    
    before = {
        "hours_logged": float(log.hours_logged),
        "billable_hours": float(log.billable_hours),
    }
    
    if data.log_date is not None: log.log_date = data.log_date
    if data.work_type is not None: log.work_type = data.work_type.value
    if data.reference_id is not None: log.reference_id = data.reference_id
    if data.reference_kind is not None: log.reference_kind = data.reference_kind.value
    if data.revision is not None: log.revision = data.revision
    if data.project_name is not None: log.project_name = data.project_name
    if data.activity_type is not None: log.activity_type = data.activity_type.value
    if data.software_used is not None: log.software_used = data.software_used
    if data.work_mode is not None: log.work_mode = data.work_mode.value
    if data.hours_logged is not None: log.hours_logged = data.hours_logged
    if data.billable_hours is not None: log.billable_hours = data.billable_hours
    if data.remarks is not None: log.remarks = data.remarks
    
    # Validate billable <= hours
    if log.billable_hours > log.hours_logged:
        raise ValueError("billable_hours cannot exceed hours_logged")
    
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(log)
    
    after = {
        "hours_logged": float(log.hours_logged),
        "billable_hours": float(log.billable_hours),
    }
    create_entry(
        db,
        action="time_log.update",
        entity_type="time_log",
        entity_id=log.id,
        user_id=actor_id,
        before_json=before,
        after_json=after,
    )
    return log


def delete_time_log(db: Session, log_id: uuid.UUID, actor_id: uuid.UUID | None) -> bool:
    log = get_time_log(db, log_id)
    if not log:
        return False
    db.delete(log)
    db.commit()
    create_entry(
        db,
        action="time_log.delete",
        entity_type="time_log",
        entity_id=log_id,
        user_id=actor_id,
    )

def aggregate_by_project(db: Session, project_id: str) -> dict:
    """Aggregate hours by project reference_id (which is the project's business_id)."""
    rows = (
        db.query(
            TimeLog.reference_id,
            func.sum(TimeLog.hours_logged).label("total_hours"),
            func.sum(TimeLog.billable_hours).label("total_billable"),
            func.count(TimeLog.id).label("count"),
        )
        .filter(TimeLog.reference_id == project_id)
        .group_by(TimeLog.reference_id)
        .all()
    )
    if not rows:
        return {
            "project_id": project_id,
            "hours_logged": Decimal("0.00"),
            "billable_hours": Decimal("0.00"),
            "count": 0,
        }
    r = rows[0]
    return {
        "project_id": project_id,
        "hours_logged": r.total_hours or Decimal("0.00"),
        "billable_hours": r.total_billable or Decimal("0.00"),
        "count": r.count,
    }

    row = (

            func.sum(TimeLog.billable_hours).label("total_billable"),

    q = db.query(

        func.sum(TimeLog.hours_logged).label("total"),
    )
    if project_id:
        q = q.filter(TimeLog.reference_id == project_id)
    row = q.one()
    total = row.total or Decimal("0.00")
    billable = row.billable or Decimal("0.00")
    return {

import uuid

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.models.user import User


def get_by_email(db: Session, email: str) -> User | None:
    return db.query(User).filter(User.email == email, User.deleted_at.is_(None)).first()


def get_by_id(db: Session, user_id: uuid.UUID) -> User | None:
    return db.query(User).filter(User.id == user_id, User.deleted_at.is_(None)).first()


def list_users(
    db: Session,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
    q: str | None = None,
    role: str | None = None,
    is_active: bool | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[User], int]:
    query = db.query(User).filter(User.deleted_at.is_(None))

    if q:
        search = f"%{q}%"
        query = query.filter(User.email.ilike(search) | User.name.ilike(search))

    if role:
        query = query.filter(User.role == role)

    if is_active is not None:
        query = query.filter(User.is_active == is_active)

    total = query.count()
    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
    items = query.order_by(User.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()

    return list(items), total


def create(
    db: Session,
    email: str,
    name: str,
    password_hash: str,
    role: str,
    employee_business_id: str | None = None,
) -> User:
    user = User(
        email=email,
        name=name,
        password_hash=password_hash,
        role=role,
        employee_business_id=employee_business_id,
    )
    db.add(user)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(user)
    return user


def update(db: Session, user: User) -> User:
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(user)
    return user


def soft_delete(db: Session, user: User) -> User:
    from datetime import UTC, datetime

    user.deleted_at = datetime.now(UTC)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(user)
    return user

import uuid

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.core.id_gen import next_business_id
from src.backend.core.security import hash_password
from src.backend.db.repositories.audit_repo import create_entry
from src.backend.db.repositories.user_repo import create as create_user
from src.backend.db.repositories.user_repo import get_by_id, list_users
from src.backend.db.repositories.user_repo import soft_delete as soft_delete_user
from src.backend.db.repositories.user_repo import update as update_user
from src.backend.models.user import User
from src.backend.schemas.user import UserCreate, UserUpdate


def list_users_service(
    db: Session,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
    q: str | None = None,
    role: str | None = None,
    is_active: bool | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[User], int, int, int]:
    items, total = list_users(db, page, page_size, q, role, is_active)
    return items, total, page, page_size


def create_user_service(db: Session, data: UserCreate, actor_id: uuid.UUID | None) -> User:
    password_hash = hash_password(data.password)
    employee_business_id = next_business_id(db, "EMP")
    user = create_user(db, data.email, data.name, password_hash, data.role.value, employee_business_id)

    if data.employee_role_code is not None:
        user.employee_role_code = data.employee_role_code.value
    if data.department is not None:
        user.department = data.department
    if data.date_of_joining is not None:
        user.date_of_joining = data.date_of_joining
    if data.employment_status is not None:
        user.employment_status = data.employment_status.value
    if data.location is not None:
        user.location = data.location
    if data.reporting_manager_id is not None:
        user.reporting_manager_id = data.reporting_manager_id
    update_user(db, user)

    create_entry(
        db,
        action="user.create",
        entity_type="user",
        entity_id=user.id,
        user_id=actor_id,
        after_json={
            "id": str(user.id),
            "email": user.email,
            "name": user.name,
            "role": user.role,
            "employee_business_id": user.employee_business_id,
        },
    )

    return user


def get_user_service(db: Session, user_id: uuid.UUID) -> User | None:
    return get_by_id(db, user_id)


def update_user_service(
    db: Session,
    user_id: uuid.UUID,
    data: UserUpdate,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
    is_self: bool = False,
) -> User | None:
    user = get_by_id(db, user_id)
    if not user:
        return None

    before_json = {
        "name": user.name,
        "role": user.role,
        "is_active": user.is_active,
        "employee_role_code": user.employee_role_code,
        "department": user.department,
        "employment_status": user.employment_status,
        "location": user.location,
        "reporting_manager_id": str(user.reporting_manager_id) if user.reporting_manager_id else None,
    }

    if data.name is not None:
        user.name = data.name
    if data.role is not None:
        if is_self:
            return None
        user.role = data.role.value
    if data.is_active is not None:
        if is_self:
            return None
        user.is_active = data.is_active
    if data.employee_role_code is not None:
        user.employee_role_code = data.employee_role_code.value
    if data.department is not None:
        user.department = data.department
    if data.date_of_joining is not None:
        user.date_of_joining = data.date_of_joining
    if data.date_of_exit is not None:
        user.date_of_exit = data.date_of_exit
    if data.employment_status is not None:
        user.employment_status = data.employment_status.value
    if data.location is not None:
        user.location = data.location
    if data.reporting_manager_id is not None:
        user.reporting_manager_id = data.reporting_manager_id

    update_user(db, user)

    after_json = {
        "name": user.name,
        "role": user.role,
        "is_active": user.is_active,
        "employee_role_code": user.employee_role_code,
        "department": user.department,
        "employment_status": user.employment_status,
        "location": user.location,
        "reporting_manager_id": str(user.reporting_manager_id) if user.reporting_manager_id else None,
    }

    create_entry(
        db,
        action="user.update",
        entity_type="user",
        entity_id=user.id,
        user_id=actor_id,
        before_json=before_json,
        after_json=after_json,
    )

    return user


def soft_delete_user_service(
    db: Session,
    user_id: uuid.UUID,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
) -> bool:
    user = get_by_id(db, user_id)
    if not user:
        return False

    before_json = {
        "deleted_at": None,
    }

    soft_delete_user(db, user)

    after_json = {
        "deleted_at": str(user.deleted_at),
    }

    create_entry(
        db,
        action="user.delete",
        entity_type="user",
        entity_id=user.id,
        user_id=actor_id,
        before_json=before_json,
        after_json=after_json,
    )

    return True
